Wednesday, June 10, 2026                             5:00 PM                          Via Zoom Video Conference


      Attendance:

                        Present  5 -  Brook Bassan, Dan Champine, Tammy Fiebelkorn, Renée Grout, and
                                        Nichole Rogers

a.    O-26-39         Amending The Integrated Development Ordinance To Revise
                        Regulations For Cannabis And Nicotine Retail Uses In Table 4-2-1:
                        Allowable Uses And Section 14-16-4-3 (Grout, by request)

                    A motion was made by Councilor Grout that this matter be Amended. Councilor
                          Grout moved Amendment No. 1. The motion carried by the following vote:

                              For:  5 -  Bassan, Champine, Fiebelkorn, Grout, and Rogers

                    A motion was made by Councilor Grout that this matter be Sent to Council
                           Without Recommendation, as Amended. The motion failed by the following
                              vote:

                              For:  2 -  Bassan, and Grout

                         Against:  3 -  Champine, Fiebelkorn, and Rogers

                    A motion was made by Councilor Fiebelkorn that this matter be Sent to Council
                             with a recommendation of Do Not Pass, as Amended. The motion carried by
                             the following vote:

                              For:  4 -  Bassan, Champine, Fiebelkorn, and Rogers

                         Against:  1 -  Grout





                           There being no further business, this meeting adjourned at 5:37 p.m.
